logsHelp.title: Logs subcommands
logsHelp.helpText:
Logs page — view runtime logs (current session + disk history).

Filters compose: /logs show + /logs level + /logs scope can all stack.
Source legend in table: [D]=disk history  [L]=live (current session)

Subcommands:
  /logs              Enter Logs page (keep current filter)
  /logs close        Return to chat page
  /logs all          Clear all filters, show full log history
  /logs errors       Set level=error only (most severe)
  /logs show <sid>   Filter by sessionId (substring match, e.g. "2026-08")
  /logs level <l>    Set min level: debug|info|warn|error
  /logs scope <s>    Set scope filter (comma-separated, e.g. "tool,provider")
  /logs help         Show this help

Examples:
  /logs show 2026-08-08_230211
  /logs level debug
  /logs scope tool,permission
  /logs show abc level error scope provider
  /logs all

Keys in Logs page:
  ↑/↓   Select entry (↑=older, ↓=newer)
  Enter Expand selected entry's full JSON
  P     Pause/resume follow new entries
  L     Cycle min level
  S     Cycle scope
  K     Cycle event kind
  /     Enter sessionId filter
  C     Clear current entries
  Esc   Return to chat page
